blocks.text: Per the corrected roadmap (turn 99), Documents 3 through 8 from the original roadmap have been consolidated into a single Master Document to avoid fragmentation and ensure strict traceability between requirements, traceability matrix, validation, management, and database design. This master document is the single source of truth for Phases 2 through 5 and the SWE1205 database deliverable.
The system follows a Dual Phase architecture established from ground observations:

items: Phase 1 (Day): Real Time Point of Sale - processes individual sales, calculates VAT, updates inventory, prints physical receipts for customers as trucks load.

Phase 2 (Evening): End of Day Reconciliation Engine - balances multi channel payment drawers (Cash, Mobile Money, Bank Deposit), logs operational expenses, computes cash variances (deficit/surplus), generates daily summary report for the Business Owner.
